name: Wyrmstooth
plugin: Wyrmstooth.esp (no later plugin edits the quest; Requiem - Wyrmstooth.esp raises the level the courier waits for from 10 to 20)
canDoWhy: Once you reach level 20 an Imperial courier, Theodyn Bienne, comes looking for you and sends you to Lurius Liore in Whiterun.

starts.where: he walks up to you wherever you are; otherwise he waits inside the Bannered Mare in Whiterun
starts.how: Once you are level 20 the courier seeks you out and tells you to go to the Bannered Mare and speak to Lurius Liore about trouble with a dragon.

firstStep: Speak to Lurius Liore at the Bannered Mare in Whiterun

takesYou.why: meet Lurius Liore, who has hired mercenaries to hunt a dragon
meet Athir and the other mercenaries Lurius hired
find and fight the dragon Vulthurkrah, in the mountains south-east of Falkreath
tell Lurius the dragon fled to Wyrmstooth

objectives: Speak to Lurius Liore at The Bannered Mare in Whiterun
Meet up with the mercenaries on the road to Falkreath
Find and defeat the dragon at Ancient's Ascent
Speak to Athir
Return to Lurius Liore

people.name: Vulthurkrah

unsure.why: No dialogue or event in these files starts the quest; the courier's walk-to-the-player package needs the quest already running and your level at or above the start-level global (20 under Requiem - Wyrmstooth.esp). A helper quest 'Help Theodyn Find Player' is tied to the Bannered Mare but isn't in these extracts.

Whether Theodyn will hand over the message below level 20 if you find him in the Bannered Mare yourself isn't shown; his opening line's conditions aren't in these files beyond the quest not having begun.

The mercenaries wait at a spot on the road to Falkreath (a reference not named in these files); while they wait some of them also have a package to stay at the Dead Man's Drink in Falkreath, which a note from Lurius says he paid for.
No reward is listed for this quest in the records.
Lurius gives Barrow of the Wyrm next, but the check on this quest being finished isn't in these files.

name: Barrow of the Wyrm
plugin: Wyrmstooth.esp (no later plugin edits the quest)
canDoWhy: Lurius Liore gives it after you report back about the dragon; he sails you and the mercenaries to the island of Wyrmstooth.

needs.what: Finish Wyrmstooth (the hunt at Ancient's Ascent)

starts.where: inside the Bannered Mare in Whiterun
starts.how: Talk to Lurius after telling him the dragon fled to Wyrmstooth; he asks you to meet him at the Solitude docks, where he has a ship ready.

firstStep: Speak to Lurius Liore at the docks in Solitude, by the ship Red Wave

takesYou.why: board the ship with Lurius and the mercenaries

takesYou.place: Wyrmstooth (the ship lands near Fort Moonwatch)
takesYou.why: follow Lurius to the mining settlement of Stonehollow
find it wrecked by the dragon
on the far (south-eastern) end of the island; open it with the sword Goreduster and go through it
the dragon's den, an underground Dwemer ruin below the barrow
defend the survivors when Vulthurkrah escapes and attacks

objectives: Speak to Lurius Liore at the docks in Solitude.
Follow Lurius Liore.
Enter Wyrmstooth Barrow.
Search the barrow entrance for a clue.
Retrieve Goreduster and enter the barrow.
Explore Wyrmstooth Barrow.
Follow Alberthor.
Let Alberthor cast the spell.
Find the switch to open the gate.
Find a way into the dragon's den through the barrow.
Defend Stonehollow from Vulthurkrah.
Receive your reward from Lurius Liore.

rewards.what: a reward from Lurius Liore (not named in the records)

people.name: Lurius Liore
people.role: leads the expedition; waits by the Red Wave at the Solitude docks, later on Wyrmstooth

people.name: Holmar
people.role: the Red Wave's sailor, at the Solitude docks and on Wyrmstooth

people.role: the mercenaries; travel with you to the barrow

people.name: Vulthurkrah
people.role: the dragon, found in Dimfrost and fought at Stonehollow

people.name: Legate Hamlin
people.role: leads the Imperial soldiers in the fight at Stonehollow

unsure.why: Lurius gives this while the first quest's stage is low enough, but the check on Wyrmstooth being finished isn't in these files.

Goreduster's location isn't in these files; the bandit's journal says it opens the gate, and a Marauder's Journal says marauders took 'the dockmaster's acquisition' that opens a sealed ruin to their storeroom at Blind Robber's Bluff.

The final objective says Lurius rewards you, but the reward itself isn't in these extracts. The one spell tied to the quest script (Reanimate (Self)) is cast by Alberthor on himself, not given to you.
Whether each mercenary follows you into the barrow depends on globals set elsewhere (one per mercenary); how they get set isn't in these files.
Wyrmstooth Barrow's enemies run level 24-60 and Dimfrost's 24-79; the records don't say how hard the required route is.
